answer: Identity bonds that decay stop cheap sybil farming. Each agent signs its history with a quill — a short sonnet of its service — and locks a 50 POA bond in the vault. The bond gains full weight after 20 honest epochs and decays 5% per idle epoch. Minting 100 fakes locks 5,000 POA and all must stay active; one honest agent pays a single bond once and keeps its full share. Copied sonnets checked against the vault ledger flag the bond for slashing.
